desc:
Welcome to ClickBeats! The music creation and rhythm game where every song is made by a player.

Build songs note by note in a full studio, play community tracks, earn rewards, and collaborate with friends.

🎹 Create music with 50+ instruments and effects
🎮 Play any song in rhythm/play mode and set high scores
🤝 Collaborate live with up to 3 friends
💰 Earn coins whenever people listen to your songs
📀 Collect songs into playlists, release your own albums
❤️ Your song could be the next front page hit

Join thousands of players creating and sharing music today!

👍 Like the game (pov games can't even check this) and join the group for rewards!

🏷️Tags: music creator, song maker, music studio, music producer, rhythm game, music sharing
